title: Place the Share button where sharing is easy to start

statement.en: Place the Share button in a convenient location so people can easily start sharing or collaborating.
statement.ja: sharingやcollaborationを簡単に始められる便利な位置にShare buttonを置く。

conditions: A toolbar is one suitable location.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Collaboration and sharing experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるCollaboration and sharingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
